# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU backend and memory-leak fixes**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, built on Skia m152. It also fixes several native memory leaks and use-after-free bugs, adds async pixel-read APIs, and ports more hot paths to managed C# for lower overhead.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m152, with an m151 upstream stability sync merged beforehand. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds SkiaSharp bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, giving consumers an early path to the next-generation GPU rendering pipeline. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async pixel readback and new native test packages** — Adds a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface, plus a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux, and containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Nano Server font support via FreeType** — Nano Server images now resolve fonts through FreeType instead of relying on unavailable platform font APIs. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native memory leaks and use-after-free bugs fixed** — Fixes a use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator by rooting the owning SKRegion, a use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* by rooting the pixel source, and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on the SKImage.Create raster failure path. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed performance ports and deterministic binding generation** — Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check, avoids an intermediate string allocation in the null-terminated GetEncodedText path, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, avoids a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo, and makes binding generation deterministic across platforms. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Platform

- **Windows native build environment hardened** — Initializes the MSVC environment once per native build instead of repeatedly, and stops pinning a fixed Windows SDK version by default. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570), [#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

No HarfBuzzSharp-facing product changes shipped in this release; the bundled binding was refreshed alongside the Skia update.
